pr_title: fix: Studio Table Editor: Selected row count incorrect when paginating
pr_body: ## What kind of change does this PR introduce? - Fixes line count per page. - Alert that marked lines will be unmarked after moving forward or back from a page - Fixes #5669 ## What is the current behavior? Incorrect selected rows count when paginating in the table editor as well as incorrect rows to delete count.. ## What is the new behavior? 1. Go to Studio Table Editor 2. Select a large table 3. Select all the cells in the current pagination 4. Navigate to the next page 5. Prior to navigating get a warning that the currently selected rows will be de-selected. Feel free to include screenshots if it includes visual changes. ## Additional context

issue_context.title: Studio Table Editor: Selected row count incorrect when paginating
issue_context.body: # Bug report ## Describe the bug Incorrect selected rows count when paginating in the table editor as well as incorrect rows to delete count. ## To Reproduce 1. Go to Studio Table Editor 2. Select a large table 3. Select all the cells in the current pagination 4. Navigate to the next page ## Expected behavior 1. Go to Studio Table Editor 2. Select a large table 3. Select all the cells in the current pagination 4. Navigate to the next page 5. Prior to navigating get a warning that the currently selected rows will be de-selected. ## Screenshots ## System information - OS: macOS - Browser: chrome
